entity.name: J. Nishanth Raj (BAVA)
entity.description: Embedded Systems Architect and creator of the Bava Protocol.

projects.name: Bava Protocol
projects.description: An ultra-lightweight, non-blocking communication architecture designed for constrained edge-devices (like ESP32/Zephyr) in industrial IoT, drastically reducing memory fragmentation.

fundingPlans.name: Bava Protocol v2 Hardware & Benchmarking Grant
fundingPlans.description: Funding required to procure industrial-grade silicon (NXP evaluation boards, Texas Instruments Launchpads) for edge-node porting, and Raspberry Pi 5 hardware to act as a central data gateway. The budget also includes scalable assets like logic analyzers, high-speed JTAG debuggers, and cloud infrastructure to benchmark v1 and architect v2 for high-performance automation.

fundingChannels.name: Direct Bank Transfer (India)
fundingChannels.description: Direct transfer upon grant approval by FOSS United.
